question: When difference between compound and simple interest for three years is ₹244 at 5% interest per annum, the principal is ₹_________
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for the difference between CI and SI for 3 years: D = P × (R/100)² × (300 + R)/100

⇒ 244 = P × (5/100)² × (305/100)

⇒ 244 = P × (1/400) × (61/20)

⇒ P = (244 × 8000) ÷ 61 = 4 × 8000 = 32000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between CI and SI (D) = ₹244

Rate (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Effective SI for 3 years = 3R

Effective CI for 3 years = 3R + 3R²/100 + R³/10000
